Description: Few events relative to the map asked for
How to detect: Event counts per year/stratum; empty cells
Mitigation options: Coarser grain; fewer covariates; do not map empty ocean
Situations where mitigation fails: Fine nowcast grids still look precise
Implications for FishAI: SBC has 11 sites; FGB n=38 in 2024

Description: Few detections so always-absent wins accuracy
How to measure impact: Prevalence; Brier of constant-zero vs model
Mitigation options: Do not model; withhold sensitive sites
Situations where mitigation fails: People still want maps of rare valuable fish
Implications for FishAI: Goliath 8 Keys events; barred sand bass 9 usable 2022 detections

Description: Many true or protocol zeros plus clumping
How to detect: Histogram of counts; extra zeros vs binomial
How to measure impact: Hurdle vs binomial Brier on later year
Mitigation options: Hurdle/delta; do not invent zeros
Implications for FishAI: RVC detection is already binary after collapse; counts still zero-inflated

Description: Species present but not recorded, or list incomplete
How to detect: Coverage of species on year list; -99999; missing vis
How to measure impact: Compare years with vs without the code
Mitigation options: NOT_EVALUATED never zero; refuse missing covariates
Situations where mitigation fails: Pacific NCRMP COUNT files have no zeros to recover
Implications for FishAI: Core FishAI constructor; Pacific remains presence-only

Description: Mis-ID, eDNA contamination, compiler errors
How to detect: Expert review; lab controls; impossible ranges
How to measure impact: Occupancy models with false-positive parameters if repeats exist
Mitigation options: Controls; withhold; do not treat compiler pins as surveys
Implications for FishAI: RVC ID error unknown; eDNA not in holdings

Description: p varies with visibility, observer, complexity, size
How to detect: Fit p covariates; residual vs vis
How to measure impact: Change in Brier when vis included (Keys kept vis)
Mitigation options: Keep vis as observation covariate not habitat
Situations where mitigation fails: No vis field (SBC missing vis dropped a row)
Implications for FishAI: Do not call vis a preference for clear water

Description: Unequal search time/area
How to measure impact: CPUE vs raw catch; offset models
Mitigation options: Standardize to one protocol; require effort
Implications for FishAI: RVC and SBC effort is the protocol itself

Description: Some habitats never sampled
How to detect: Map of effort vs habitat raster
Mitigation options: Support mask; refuse unsampled habitat
Implications for FishAI: Predictions only on surveyed habitat classes

Description: Same sites dominate (SBC fixed; citizen hotspots)
How to measure impact: Cluster bootstrap by site; site-out CV
Mitigation options: Cluster SEs; do not treat revisits as new places
Implications for FishAI: SBC bootstrap over 11 sites; Keys PSU clustering

Description: Samples near ramps, cities, calm days
Mitigation options: Prefer probability samples; bias layers for compilers
Situations where mitigation fails: Cannot recover unsampled wilderness from pins
Implications for FishAI: RVC is stratified random; GBIF is not

Description: Surveys miss fish outside the band; surface env used for bottom fish
How to detect: Depth range of gear vs species; SST vs bottom T
How to measure impact: Skill of surface vs depth-resolved T (Keys: depth T did not help)
Mitigation options: Join at occupied depth; do not use SST as bottom proxy without evidence
Implications for FishAI: HYCOM at dive depth was the right test; still failed as kept feature

Description: Only summer surveys
Mitigation options: Restrict card to survey months; refuse other seasons
Situations where mitigation fails: Dynamic habitat products still draw winter maps
Implications for FishAI: SBC late Jul-Aug only; RVC mostly summer

Description: Trawl vs diver vs camera catch different sizes/habitats
How to measure impact: Catchability ratios; hold out a gear
Mitigation options: Separate likelihoods; never pool y
Implications for FishAI: Do not mix RVC and DATRAS zeros

Description: Skill and behavior differ among divers
How to detect: Observer IDs if recorded; residual clustering
Mitigation options: Observer random effects if IDs exist
Implications for FishAI: Not in current Keys model

Description: Splits/synonyms split a series
How to measure impact: Sudden prevalence jumps at list changes
Mitigation options: WoRMS map; do not invent AphiaIDs
Implications for FishAI: Codes used raw

Description: Cylinder radius, time, or list changes
Mitigation options: Segment models; do not pool silently
Implications for FishAI: RVC list size changes by year; zeros only if code on list

Description: Coastal cells NaN; chlorophyll masked
How to measure impact: Dropped rows; Keys HYCOM ~51% ocean cells at 0-30 m
Mitigation options: Nearest valid ocean cell with km cap; refuse if none
Implications for FishAI: Documented in Keys env QA; chl not used

Description: Land bleed; wrong shoreline
Mitigation options: Barrier SPDE; land mask
Implications for FishAI: Required if spatial models are fit

Description: SST, season, and depth travel together
How to measure impact: Unstable coefficients; CV vs later-year disagreement
Mitigation options: Drop redundant; pre-register one thermal metric
Implications for FishAI: Temperature kept in SBC CV then failed 2022

Description: Nearby dives not independent
Mitigation options: Cluster bootstrap; spatial GLMM
Implications for FishAI: Already cluster by PSU/site

Description: Years are few and dependent
Mitigation options: Later-year holdout only
Implications for FishAI: PR 2023 and SBC/Keys 2022 burned for tested species

Description: Schools make extra zeros and extra highs
Mitigation options: Hurdle; do not claim abundance from detection
Implications for FishAI: Detection still OK for common site-attached reef fish

Description: Closure fails
Mitigation options: Shorter windows; do not use N-mixture on RVC
Implications for FishAI: Occupancy not supported on current design

Description: Predict beyond observed envelope
Mitigation options: Refuse out-of-range; mask
Implications for FishAI: predict() refuses; score() still scored 5 cold SBC rows

Description: Test climate outside training
How to measure impact: Later-year failure after CV pass (P009; kelp bass)
Mitigation options: Do not keep env terms that fail later years; ensemble climate only for Q9
Situations where mitigation fails: No amount of SST skill in 2014-2018 guarantees 2022
Implications for FishAI: Treat heatwave and post-heatwave years as novelty

Description: Effort follows expected catch
How to detect: Effort map vs habitat; fishery vs survey mismatch
Mitigation options: Designed surveys; joint sampling models; never AIS-as-fish
Implications for FishAI: Safety: no catch hotspots

Description: Future covariates, holdout reuse, multiple estimators as one
Mitigation options: Causal offsets {0,-1,-2}; freeze; one estimator; locks
Implications for FishAI: Guards exist; do not rescore burned years

Description: Test year env or prevalence differs
How to detect: Train vs test histograms; calibration gap
Mitigation options: Survey-only model; drop shifted covariate
Implications for FishAI: Main remaining failure mode for 'working' models

Description: Spatial CV and bootstrap underpowered
How to measure impact: CI includes 0 even when ranking looks OK
Mitigation options: Do not fit spatial fields; do not claim nowcast
Situations where mitigation fails: More years at the same 11 sites still 11 places
Implications for FishAI: SBC models failed; Channel Islands would be a new frame
